threat: A narrowly-scoped personal access token acts with the principal's full authority (the ability narrowing travels but is not read)
test_result: 200 for the granted capability, 403 outside it
severity_if_unmitigated: a leaked scoped token would be as powerful as the account
residual_risk: none - the narrowing is a ceiling at the policy boundary

threat: A DNS answer that changes between the egress check and the connect (rebinding) sends the request to a private address
attack_surface: any outbound HTTP call whose URL is attacker-influenced
test_result: the resolver refuses a private answer; the refused target is never contacted
severity_if_unmitigated: an SSRF to the metadata service (169.254.169.254) or the database port
residual_risk: none once the policy is enabled; the policy is permissive by default, so a deployment that wants the guard must opt in

threat: A miscompiled WASM guest escapes the sandbox boundary
asset: the module sandbox (linear memory, capabilities, tenant isolation)
severity_if_unmitigated: a guest could read or write outside its own memory - the module model's central promise
residual_risk: CRITICAL and unresolved - the runtime binaries all carry the vulnerable wasmtime

threat: A guest's handle tables grow without being charged to any limit
asset: the host's memory (the module resource budget)
severity_if_unmitigated: host memory exhaustion from one guest

threat: A malicious certificate chain (a distrusted intermediate) is accepted for an outbound TLS connection
asset: the confidentiality and integrity of outbound calls
attack_surface: every outbound HTTPS call and the OTLP exporter
severity_if_unmitigated: a MITM against outbound traffic and telemetry

threat: A certificate compression bomb allocates up to 1 GiB before authentication
trust_boundary: the network -> the host (the TLS handshake)
severity_if_unmitigated: a remote memory-exhaustion vector from a single handshake

threat: A TLS session's secrets reach the log through a Debug impl
attack_surface: any code path that debug-prints a rustls session
severity_if_unmitigated: session secrets in the log pipeline

threat: A deployment whose config omits `database.required` serves traffic from a volatile in-memory store
attack_surface: any production deployment with an incomplete config
test_evidence: the boot log line `database unreachable; booting degraded on in-memory backend`
residual_risk: MEDIUM - /readyz reports the degradation (a mitigation), but direct traffic still reaches a volatile store

threat: A request-scoped secret (the PAT) leaks into a log or an error body
asset: the token store and the log pipeline
attack_surface: the error renderer and the debug logs
test_evidence: the redaction cases in the http and observability suites; the `Secret` type's redacted Debug
test_result: the secret surfaces are redacted; the Secret type wipes its buffer on drop
severity_if_unmitigated: token disclosure through a log or an error body
residual_risk: LOW - the redaction posture is proven, but the coverage is per-surface rather than systematic

threat: A cross-tenant read through a shared connection or an unscoped query
trust_boundary: the tenant boundary (the store, the queue, the events, the cache, the files)
test_evidence: the tenant_isolation_* cases (the queue, the events, the cache, the storage)
test_result: green in the unit and contract suites
residual_risk: MEDIUM - the isolation is proven at the store level; the **RLS** assertion on a real PostgreSQL is unnamed, so the database's own guard is unproven

threat: A path traversal or a symlink escape reaches a file outside the disk root
trust_boundary: the storage root -> the host filesystem
attack_surface: uploads, downloads, the local disk driver
severity_if_unmitigated: arbitrary file read/write on the host
residual_risk: LOW after the F-24 fix (the link component is refused and the resolved ancestor is re-checked)

threat: A spoofed upload is stored and later served as its declared type
trust_boundary: the upload edge -> the object store
severity_if_unmitigated: a stored object whose bytes contradict its declared type
residual_risk: LOW after the F-27 fix (the declared type is checked against the sniffed bytes)

threat: A rate limit is bypassed by a forged client key or a process-local bucket
test_evidence: the trusted-proxy chain cases; the live-Redis shared-store cases
severity_if_unmitigated: unlimited abuse of a protected endpoint
residual_risk: LOW (the shared store and the trusted-proxy chain are proven)

threat: A session is not rotated or revoked after an authentication change
trust_boundary: the auth boundary -> the session store
test_evidence: the reset invalidation cases; the concurrent reset case
severity_if_unmitigated: session fixation or a stale session surviving a reset
residual_risk: LOW (the reset path invalidates the sessions and the tokens)

threat: The CI accepts an unverified or unpinned artifact
test_result: the licences and sources are clean, the advisories are NOT
severity_if_unmitigated: a compromised or miscompiled artifact in a release
residual_risk: MEDIUM - the digests and the drift detector are real, but the SBOM/provenance generators are untracked and the advisories are unresolved

threat: The audit trail is tampered with or leaks sensitive content
source_paths: crates/execution (the audit records); crates/security/tokens (the sealed envelope)
test_evidence: the audit recorder cases; the sealed-envelope cases
severity_if_unmitigated: a repudiated or over-shared audit trail
residual_risk: LOW-MEDIUM - the sealing is proven; the retention and the access model are not

threat: An unbounded input exhausts the host (the body, the upload, the query, the regex)
test_evidence: the byte-cap cases; the loop-cap cases; the multipart part cap
test_result: green for the paths that are covered
residual_risk: MEDIUM - the covered paths are bounded, but the atlas's missing limits (the request-cost, the query-cost, the buffer bounds) are unnamed

threat: A dependency is compromised in transit (an unpinned or unverified source)
test_result: zero git dependencies; the registry is the only source
residual_risk: LOW - the posture is good, but the 10 advisories show the pinning is not the same as being current
